The Battle of Commagene in AD 140, is a poorly documented pitched-battle that took place between Vologases III's faction of the Parthian Empire, and Mithridates V's faction, togheter with his son Sanatruces II.
Location
The Battle took place somehere in Commagene (the ancient Kingdom of Commagene), however, the exact place is unknown. Commagene was part of Roman Syria at the time of the battle.
